\begin{bankq}[id=SI04-P2-CHEM-S1-Q08, source={Score-I - Test 04 (14 Jan 2022)}, paper=2, qno=8, type=single, subtopic={Balancing}, answer={C}, answer_src=key, difficulty=3, diff_parts={K1 S1 I1 C1 F0}, diff_note={concepts: permanganate with hydrogen peroxide in acid | steps: 2 MnO4- + 5 H2O2 + 6 H+ -> 2 Mn2+ + 5 O2 + 8 H2O; identify the gas or oxidation state}]
The reaction of permagnanate ions with hydrogen peroxide in an acidic solution gives Mn(II) salt and at the same time oxygen is released

(P) $2\mathrm{MnO_4^-}+\mathrm{H_2O_2}+6\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow2\mathrm{Mn^{+2}}+3\mathrm{O_2}+4\mathrm{H_2O}$

(Q) $2\mathrm{MnO_4^-}+3\mathrm{H_2O_2}+6\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow2\mathrm{Mn^{+2}}+4\mathrm{O_2}+6\mathrm{H_2O}$

(R) $2\mathrm{MnO_4^-}+5\mathrm{H_2O_2}+6\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow2\mathrm{Mn^{+2}}+5\mathrm{O_2}+8\mathrm{H_2O}$

(S) $2\mathrm{MnO_4^-}+7\mathrm{H_2O_2}+6\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow2\mathrm{Mn^{+2}}+3\mathrm{O_2}+10\mathrm{H_2O}$

Which of the above reaction is balanced correctly ?
\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{P}
\opt{B}{Q}
\opt{C}{R}
\opt{D}{S}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}

\end{qoptions}
